title: IT Applications and Analytics Analyst LATAM
description:
Company Description

Red Bull gives wings to all people, to fly in whichever direction they want, respecting and tolerating the trajectory of each one, regardless of gender expression, race, religion, affective-sexual orientation, origin, age or disability. In the world of Red Bull, everyone is welcome.

The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM acts upon the global IT strategy, is responsible for the IT relevant coordination and communication of global business applications, their deployments within the area and head-coach regions, supporting demand process and service ownership for regional and local business applications.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· The IT Application & Analytics LATAM works thoroughly aligned with HQs BA service owners, HQ Data Team, BRMs and local peers of IT and business to ensure staying informed about relevant projects for counterparts in countries.

· The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM is responsible for service ownership and management of specific LATAM Analytics products.

· The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM is also responsible for assessing insights related demands from the different areas of the business (sales , logistics, marketing, etc), scoping the need and identifying the right technology together with it’s counterparts in LATAM or HQ. For the realization of analytics demands, the IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM either relies on the skillset of other peers in the organization or will directly integrate and visualize data.

DEMAND CAPTURE & ALIGNMENT PROCESS SUPPORT

· Person acts as regional counterpart for Analytics requests.

· Capturing, scoping, documenting and prioritizing local demands (incl. HQ security or local privacy requirements).

· Thorough understanding of the underlying business case.

· Enabling the business-to-business communication.

· Ensuring a well-prepared and transparent decision process.

· Communication and explanation of taken decisions.

SUPPORTING SERVICE DELIVERY & PROJECTS

· Project oversight for global or regional projects.

· Project documentation and action plans on communication, training, handover, support.

· Stakeholder communication.

· Third Party Management.

· Satisfaction of business and users with new services or the operation throughout.

SUPPORTING SERVICE OWNERSHIP, OPERATION & CSI PROCESSES

· Service ownership for aligned and agreed regional services.

· Management and coordination of external support & development partners.

· Alignment with local and global service owners to ensure strategy fit of solutions.

· Alignment, development and maintenance of service roadmaps within the IT area.

· Ensure country requirements are communicated to global service owners.

· Regular review of operational KPIs to ensure insights on the service knowledge and performance are generated and improvement actions are derived.

ANALYTICS

· Assessing analytics demands from teams across the area LATAM.

· Performing user interviews to understand the different interests of the people involved.

· Analyzing the different data involved and their sources.

· Working with HQ Data committee to define a goal for the data visualization.

· Identifying data integration options, methods and technology.

· Aligning the approach with decision makers in the area LATAM and HQ.

· Support the realization process through externals or realization autonomously depending on the topic and the skill set.

· Closing demands ensuring success.

· Documenting and managing analytics use cases throughout their lifecycle.

Qualifications

Degree in computer science, business informatics or equivalent experience.

Strong communicator and relator, solid and broad business process understanding.

Project Management experience, ITIL knowhow beyond theory.

Team-oriented, self-driven and motivated personality, hands-on and flexible, thinking from the end.

Ability to understand complex and different types of requirements and translate those into technical concepts.

Excellent skills to interact with all levels of employees/executives.

Precise, systematic, accuracy and structured way of working.

Performance and result orientation.

Spoken and written English mandatory, Spanish a plus.

Strong mathematical skills to help collect, measure, organize and analyze data.

Interest or experience on working with analytics skills, such as data management and visualization.

Technical proficiency regarding database design development, data models, techniques for data mining and segmentation.

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Account Manager

We deliver a complete range of solutions — from “software-only” offerings to fully managed sports betting platform stacks — ensuring stability, flexibility, and personalized service . Our software is developed and operated entirely in-house and powered by premium-quality data feeds .

The ideal candidate will have a strong focus on client satisfaction, relationship management, and operational excellence, ensuring that each client receives outstanding support and value from our products and services.

  • Serve as the primary contact for client needs, inquiries, and concerns.
  • Build and nurture strong client relationships to foster retention and growth.
  • Oversee client accounts, ensuring services meet business goals, expectations, and budgets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams — including sales, product, and operations — to deliver tailored solutions.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues, continuously improving client experience and internal processes.
  • Work closely with the product team to align updates and features with client expectations.

  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for clients, ensuring a seamless and positive partnership.


Requirements & Skills:

  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to collect, track, and interpret data effectively.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Problem-solving attitude and adaptability in fast-paced environments.
  • Proven ability to build rapport and collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Experience in the sports betting or iGaming industry is a strong advantage.


What We Offer

  • A stable, flexible, and collaborative working environment.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A multinational team of industry experts from around the world.

title: Coordenador(a) de RevOps & Pricing
description:
Estamos buscando uma pessoa estratégica, analítica e orientada a resultados para assumir a coordenação da área de Revenue Operations & Pricing. Essa posição será responsável por liderar a inteligência de receita da companhia, conectando dados, comportamento do consumidor e análises profundas para impulsionar crescimento, previsibilidade e rentabilidade.

Você terá papel central na criação de metodologias, processos e rituais que integram Marketing, Growth, Produto, Comercial, Financeiro e Dados, garantindo uma visão única e integrada de receita, performance e oportunidades.


Missão do Cargo

Ser o centro de inteligência de receita e precificação da empresa, transformando dados e análises em decisões estratégicas e operacionais que maximizem resultados de forma sustentável.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a estratégia de Revenue Operations e Pricing, integrando dados, tecnologia e inteligência de negócio para decisões assertivas.
  • Construir e conduzir o Comitê de Receita, trazendo análises por cohort, tipo de produto x cliente, LTV, CAC, churn e margens por cluster.
  • Desenvolver, revisar e aprimorar o forecast de receita e rentabilidade com base em histórico, comportamento de consumo, pricing e sazonalidade.
  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a metodologia de precificação, garantindo alinhamento entre valor percebido, posicionamento e margem de contribuição.
  • Realizar estudos de elasticidade de preço por região, produto e perfil de cliente, com recomendações práticas para cada segmento.
  • Testar modelos de preço dinâmico para campanhas, ofertas e ocupação, equilibrando volume, margem e acessibilidade.
  • Recomendação de pricing para novos produtos, ajustes de portfólio e campanhas promocionais.
  • Monitorar e mensurar o impacto das estratégias de preço ao longo do tempo, analisando elasticidade, variação de margem e performance.
  • Garantir governança e consistência das bases de dados de receita e preço, assegurando padronização e atualização contínua.
  • Criar dashboards executivos e relatórios analíticos sobre performance, forecast, rentabilidade e oportunidades por canal e produto.
  • Cocriar com Growth, Performance, CRM e Comercial planos que integrem precificação, engajamento e ocupação.
  • Ser parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das áreas de negócio, traduzindo dados em insights e ações práticas que acelerem resultados.

• Administração de servidores Windows e/ou Linux.

• Experiência com virtualização (VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox) ou ambientes em nuvem.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de observabilidade, monitoramento e gestão de logs (Zabbix, Grafana, Elastic, etc.).

• Experiência com hardening e padrões de segurança (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS).

Diferenciais

title: Government Relations Director, Brazil
description:
SHEIN

Founded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,

Singapore, Los Angeles, and other key markets around the world. SHEIN reaches consumers


in more than 150 locations globally, enabling them to access more fashion, beauty and

lifestyle products easily and conveniently, at affordable prices. Our mission is to help

everyone - regardless of their location, body size, ethnicity, income level - express their

individuality through access to the latest trends.


SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,

collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to

come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and

enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN’s growth and expansion globally, making

it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.


Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN’s business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN’s various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.


In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN’s corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.


Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN’s commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN’s senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN’s network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company’s overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management’s reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms


Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: Telecommunications Project Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Project Manager in the Telecommunications sector to lead complex initiatives involving network deployment, modernization, and expansion. This professional will be responsible for delivering projects on time, within scope, budget, and quality standards, while ensuring strong alignment between clients, technical teams, vendors, and senior management.


This is a full on-site position at our São Paulo – Berrini office.



Key Responsibilities


  • Plan, execute, monitor, and close telecom projects (RAN, Core, IP, FTTH, DWDM, power and site infrastructure).
  • Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and quality indicators (SLAs, KPIs), ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and customer requirements.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams (engineering, deployment, logistics, suppliers, and subcontractors).
  • Lead regular meetings with telecom operators and internal stakeholders, ensuring transparency, governance, and alignment.
  • Identify, analyze, and mitigate technical, operational, and commercial risks.
  • Prepare and present executive reports to clients and senior management, highlighting progress, risks, and key decisions.
  • Ensure compliance with telecom regulations (e.g., ANATEL) and international quality standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management processes, aiming at efficiency, scalability, and cost optimization.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Project Management, Telecommunications, or related areas is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in project management, with a strong background in the telecommunications sector.
  • Solid experience in project management within the telecommunications sector (mobile networks, fixed networks, or backbone).
  • Strong technical knowledge of telecom technologies (4G/5G RAN, IP/MPLS, DWDM, FTTH, power and infrastructure for telecom sites).
  • Proven experience managing projects of high complexity, involving multiple vendors and Tier-1 telecom operators.
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies (PMBOK, Agile, hybrid).
  • Certifications are a plus: PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, ITIL.
  • English is the primary working language; fluency is required. Portuguese fluency both written and spoken is a must.
  • Availability to work full on-site at the São Paulo – Berrini office.



Preferred Competencies


  • Strong leadership skills and ability to engage technical and field teams.

  • Competitive compensation package and continuous training programs.

Temos o DNA de varejo, já que nascemos da Pernambucanas – marca centenária que sempre contou com os serviços financeiros para apoiar as famílias brasileiras de maneira fácil e democrática. Ao longo dos anos, as soluções evoluíram e se diversificaram, permitindo à Pefisa se consolidar no mercado financeiro.

Somos responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e gestão de produtos como cartões, empréstimo pessoal, seguros e a conta digital, com diferenciais como simplicidade, praticidade e sem burocracia. Prezamos por bons relacionamentos, pelo atendimento próximo e por jogar junto.

Com mais de 5 milhões de clientes ativos e grande relevância na área do varejo, disponibilizamos um amplo portfólio de serviços para pessoas físicas e jurídicas, além de um Banking as a Service (BaaS) para marcas de diversos segmentos. Com isso, adotamos iniciativas inovadoras para clientes e parceiros.

Na Pefisa tudo é simples. Tudo é rápido. Te ajudamos com o que você precisa para realizar seus sonhos ou alavancar seu negócio. E você escolhe como quer conversar, pois nós somos Fígital. Atuamos com a melhor experiência entre o físico e o digital, com nossas plataformas digitais ou através de nossas lojas físicas. Somos a fintech pra gente como a gente.


Analista de Controles Internos e Conformidades Jr (Foco RO, Compliance e CI)


Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em em Administração, Direito, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas e áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento de produtos e serviços bancários, especialmente do Varejo Bancário (Seguros, Conta Digital, Cartões e Operações de Crédito);
  • Conhecimento sobre Direito do Consumidor e normas regulatórias associadas aos produtos supracitados;
  • Experiência prévia em Riscos Operacionais, Compliance, Controles Internos, Auditoria ou Riscos Não Financeiros;
  • Perfil analítico, orientado a dados, detalhista, curioso e proativo;
  • Habilidade de comunicação, questionamento e proposta de soluções;
  • Habilidade em administrar múltiplas demandas com prioridade baseada em risco;
  • Domínio das ferramentas do pacote Office.


Atividades:

  • Mapear os processos, riscos, controles e produtos da Pefisa, visando antecipar e identificar potenciais riscos operacionais e regulatórios (Metodologia COSO, Risk Self Assessment , etc.);
  • Atuar proativamente na identificação, análise, avaliação, controle e mitigação dos riscos inerentes aos processos que a empresa está exposta, possibilitando a evolução contínua da maturidade da cultura de riscos.
  • Controlar e propor mitigantes de risco, visando reduzir perdas operacionais, com ênfase em: falhas operacionais, contingências cíveis e gestão de fraudes.
  • Analisar e emitir pareceres, sob a ótica de riscos operacionais e regulatórios, para os processos e produtos financeiros da Pefisa.
  • Prestar apoio aos gestores do negócio na elaboração e follow-up dos planos de ação para mitigação de riscos identificados nos trabalhos internos e externos.
  • Apoiar na construção de indicadores, dashboards e materiais que suportem à administração quanto aos temas de Gestão de Riscos Operacionais e de Conformidade.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios regulatórios (Resolução CMN 4.968/21, circular nº 3978/20, 4.595/17, Resolução nº 4.595/17, etc.)
  • Atendimento às demandas da auditoria (interna e externa) e reguladores.


Será considerado diferencial:

  • Experiência com analytics, através do desenvolvimento de indicadores e monitoramento continuo utilizando ferramentas, tais como: Vertex, CoPilot, Python, Knime, Powerbi, DataBricks, SQL e outras;
  • Conhecimento de normas BCB e relatórios regulatórios (Resolução CMN 4.968/21, Circular BC nº 3978/20, Resolução CMN 4.595/17, Resolução CMN nº 4.557/17, etc.);
  • Conhecimento de Gestão Integrada de Riscos e Declaração de Apetite a Risco (RAS – Risk Appetite Statement).


Nossos benefícios:

Assistência Médica Mediservice (cooparticipação);

Assistência Odontológica Odontoseg (por adesão);

Vale-Alimentação;

Vale-Refeição;

Vale Cultura (por adesão);

PPR;

Desconto nos produtos Pernambucanas;

Auxilio Creche;

Plano de Carreira;

Parceria com instituições de Ensino para cursos de graduação, pós graduação e descontos em curso de idiomas.

Graduação em Design, Comunicação Visual, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas.

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;

  • Análise de Dados;

title: Secretária administrativa
description:
Vaga: Secretária Administrativa

Resumo do cargo

A pessoa que ocupar esta função será responsável por oferecer suporte administrativo e operacional a diferentes áreas da organização, garantindo que as atividades do dia a dia fluam de forma eficiente e organizada. Atuará como ponto de apoio entre a equipe, a direção e o público externo, contribuindo para o bom andamento das rotinas e o alcance dos objetivos institucionais.

Como ter sucesso neste cargo

Para ter sucesso nesta posição, é essencial demonstrar proatividade, discrição, atenção aos detalhes e excelente capacidade de comunicação. A pessoa ideal saberá priorizar demandas, manter a confidencialidade de informações estratégicas e apresentar postura colaborativa. O sucesso será medido pela capacidade de manter a estrutura administrativa fluindo de forma organizada e pelo apoio efetivo às lideranças e equipes.

Como este cargo se encaixa na organização

A função de Secretária Administrativa é fundamental para a integração dos processos internos, servindo como elo entre diferentes setores. Essa posição garante a eficiência das operações diárias e contribui diretamente para que a gestão mantenha foco nas decisões estratégicas, sabendo que as rotinas administrativas estão sob controle.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar agendas, compromissos e reuniões, assegurando organização e pontualidade.
  • Elaborar, revisar e arquivar documentos administrativos e correspondências oficiais.
  • Atender e direcionar comunicações internas e externas, com clareza e cordialidade.
  • Apoiar o controle de despesas, elaboração de relatórios e acompanhamento de pagamentos.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de gestão na preparação de apresentações, relatórios e eventos corporativos.
  • Manter o controle de materiais de escritório e suprimentos, garantindo o bom funcionamento do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Apoiar processos de recrutamento, integração de novos colaboradores e gestão de registros administrativos.
  • Zelar pela confidencialidade das informações e pelo cumprimento das políticas internas da organização.
Qualificações
  • Formação técnica ou superior em Administração, Secretariado Executivo ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em funções administrativas ou de secretariado.
  • Domínio do pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) e ferramentas de comunicação digital.
  • Competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com atenção à clareza e à formalidade adequada.
  • Capacidade de organização, planejamento e gestão do tempo.
  • Habilidade para lidar com múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente e resolver problemas de forma autônoma.
  • Postura ética, profissional e colaborativa em todas as interações.

title: Leader-Merchant Informatization
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.
  2. Mechanism and Process Development: Establish comprehensive internal and external collaboration workflows and oversight mechanisms, continuously optimizing processes to ensure the team accurately and efficiently serves business needs.
  3. Core Metric Monitoring: Monitor and report key onboarding metrics, proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for merchants.
  4. Team Collaboration: Work closely with sales, compliance, and product teams to streamline the onboarding process and meet merchant needs.
  5. Team Development and Capacity Building: Develop training materials and conduct onboarding training for new employees and merchants as needed.


Job Requirements

  1. Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  2. Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  3. A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  4. A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  5. Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  6. Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Corporate Lawyer / Account Manager
description:
We’re Hiring! Account Manager (Corporate Management Services) – Brazil (On site)


Corporate Administrator | Company Management Services


Amicorp Group is expanding our team in Brazil, and we are looking for an experienced Account Manager (Corporate Administrator) to join our Corporate Management Services division.


If you enjoy working with international clients, managing complex corporate structures, and acting as a trusted advisor on legal, administrative, and corporate governance matters — this opportunity is for you.


About the Role

As a Account Manager, you will manage a portfolio of clients and ensure their legal and corporate structures remain fully compliant and in good standing. You will guide clients on regulatory, fiscal, and administrative matters while supporting the growth of the business through exceptional service and relationship building.

You will be responsible for:


✔ Managing and administering companies, partnerships, and trusts

✔ Structuring and maintaining corporate entities for clients

✔ Providing guidance on corporate governance, regulations, and fiscal opportunities

✔ Reviewing and preparing corporate documents: minutes, proxies, registers, resolutions

✔ Coordinating with internal teams (Accounting, Compliance, Legal)

✔ Ensuring timely and accurate billing through Maconomy

✔ Monitoring financial targets, chargeability, and productivity

✔ Ensuring KYC compliance and meeting communication KPIs

✔ Acting as a trusted advisor and building long-term client relationships

✔ Supporting business development through client referrals and portfolio growth


This is a client-facing, revenue-generating role for someone who enjoys ownership, responsibility, and building meaningful professional relationships.


What We’re Looking For


Required qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Business, Accounting, Tax, or related areas

Experience with foreign structures in BVI or Cayman

4 years of experience in corporate services, financial services, or corporate governance

Strong knowledge of corporate structures, regulatory requirements, and compliance

Experience with director/shareholder changes

Fluent English; additional languages are a plus

Strong communication and client relationship skills

Commercial mindset and target-driven approach

Ability to work independently and handle a full portfolio

Hands-on, proactive, organized, and detail-oriented


Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, you will be part of a global organization with a local, dynamic team environment. We offer a collaborative, multicultural workplace where you will have direct impact on client portfolios and contribute to the growth of the business.


Interested?

If this role fits your background and career goals, we would love to hear from you!

Apply or send your CV to: c.garci a@amicorp.com


Join us and be part of a global group shaping the future of corporate and fiduciary services.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (New Business Sales) - Brasil
description:
Enterprise Account Executive (New Business Sales) - Brasil (São Paolo)


A little about ADP: We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR, payroll, talent, time, tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics, and compliance expertise. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating a down-to-earth culture that embraces our core values, welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition for our work by many esteemed organizations, learn more at ADP Awards and Recognition .


The Role:

  • New business sales to Enterprise clients who have 1,000 – 2,500 employees in Brasil (can have even higher numbers of employees globally)
  • Selling across ADP Brasil’s Payroll and HR solutions – full sales and delivery support in place for both local and global deals
  • The types of deals that you get to work on will vary; it could be a local deal taking 3-9 month with 3/4 stakeholders at $100,000 (USD) in year 1 revenue, or significantly more for a larger global deal.


Key Duties / Tasks:

  • Collaborate with your sales leaders to create your annual business plan, determining sales targets and actions to achieve the established quota; achieve and exceed quota through the assigned portfolio
  • Produce a 120-Day Prospect Report, which identifies potential companies and actions to close a contract - use a variety of tools available at your disposal to plan, execute, and track your targeted new business
  • Arrange prospect appointments and undertake virtual and in-person meetings / demos
  • Identify customer dissatisfaction with existing products and services and execute action plans to resolve issues and retain customers
  • Co-ordinate internal resource and support, in line with a structured sales process (provided), to appropriately run your deals and maximise success
  • Work with presales when necessary to develop solutions to fit prospect needs
  • Present response to meet prospect needs with existing product service solution
  • Maintain chosen ADP data base management tool and adhere to the current defined sales processes


Education and Experience:

  • 3-5 years of new business sales experience in IT Solutions / Services / HR in Brazil
  • Full Right to Work and a full driving licence in Brasil
  • Commutable to São Paolo 3 days per week
  • Experience in outbound lead generation and proactively growing a new business territory
  • A background of carrying and achieving / exceeding annual net new business annual quotas excess of $300k (USD)
  • Track record of managing complex sales cycles and closing deals in the $50-100k (USD) annual revenue range
  • Ideally you will have experience selling multi country products, but this is not essential
  • Must be fluent in Portuguese and English


What We Offer. This role offers the perfect platform for sales professionals to be fully supported to win global, complex deals, develop their career, and earn:


  • World class, structured induction programme
  • Highly competitive salary and compensation plan
  • A world class induction programme and individual on-going training – both locally and internationally
  • Realistic targets and earnings - we support our associates to overachieve.
  • We also celebrate success regularly with early starts, quarterly and annual awards, clubs and trips. Recent examples include everything from all-inclusive cruises, to local sports events and luxury 5 start resort vacations.
  • Excellent sales support and enablement teams to help you get there! We offer Sales Development Representatives and Marketing support to help generate leads. Then there's a full pre-sales team who are there to support you with everything from client assessments, recommendation documentation and software demonstrations
  • Global brand, 75+ years of heritage, and a strong presence in Brasil and LATAM
  • Flexible benefits program


If this sounds like you and what you're looking for, or if you'd like to learn more, then please do get in touch!

title: Country Manager – Hospitality & Tourism
description:
Role Description

We are seeking an ambitious and commercially minded Country Manager to lead and grow our business in Brazil, based in São Paulo.

This is a key strategic role combining sales leadership, business development, and operational excellence within the hospitality and tourism sectors. You will be responsible for expanding our client base, strengthening partnerships with hotel groups and travel brands, and leading a local team to deliver our world-class audit and risk management solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the commercial growth strategy for Brazil, with a focus on new business acquisition and account expansion across hotels, resorts, and tourism operators.
  • Build and nurture relationships with hotel owners, operators, and corporate offices to identify opportunities and deliver tailored risk management solutions.
  • Take full ownership of the P&L, ensuring consistent, profitable, and sustainable growth.
  • Lead and inspire a team of auditors and coordinators to deliver high-quality service and exceptional client satisfaction.
  • Oversee operational excellence and ensure adherence to Cristal and Intertek quality standards.
  • Be an Ambassador for Intertek Cristal at industry events, trade shows, and client meetings to strengthen brand awareness and market positioning in Brazil.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Proven sales and business development background with strong results in growth and client retention.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to motivate and manage diverse teams.
  • Deep understanding of the hospitality, tourism, or travel sectors in Brazil.
  • Solid commercial and financial acumen, with hands-on P&L ownership experience.
  • Strong relationship-building, communication, and presentation skills; confident engaging with senior decision-makers.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive, results-oriented approach.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).


Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity to lead and expand the operations of a trusted global brand in one of the most dynamic hospitality markets in the world. You will join a passionate, international team dedicated to raising standards in safety, quality, and guest experience across the travel and tourism industry.

title: Analista de Sinistros Pleno
description:
SOBRE A SEDGEWICK:

Cuidar das pessoas está no centro de tudo o que fazemos, e começamos cuidando de você, nosso valioso colaborador. Uma carreira na Sedgwick significa entrar em contato com nossa cultura de cuidado. Significa ter flexibilidade e tempo para todas as coisas que são importantes para você. É uma oportunidade de fazer algo significativo todos os dias. É ter apoio para suas necessidades mentais, físicas, financeiras e profissionais. Significa aprimorar suas habilidades e desenvolver sua carreira. E isso significa trabalhar em um ambiente que celebre a diversidade e seja justo e inclusivo.


Uma carreira na Sedgwick é onde a paixão encontra o propósito de gerar um impacto positivo no mundo por meio das pessoas e organizações que servimos. Se você é uma pessoa motivada a fazer a diferença, que gosta de desafios e, acima de tudo, é uma pessoa que se importa, há um lugar para você aqui. Junte-se a nós e contribua para que a Sedgwick seja um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.


Great Place to Work®

Top 100 Most Loved Workplace®

Melhor empregador do estado de acordo com a Forbes



OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Realizar todas as etapas de um processo de regulação de sinistros. Seus principais objetivos incluem garantir uma resposta eficiente e eficaz aos sinistros relatados pelos segurados, assegurando uma resolução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes envolvidas. Atuar na análise detalhada das circunstâncias do sinistro, na avaliação dos danos e na determinação das coberturas aplicáveis à apólice de seguro. Conduzir as comunicações com os segurados, corretores, agentes e outros envolvidos no processo, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo orientações e negociando acordos quando necessário. O Analista de Sinistros também trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, financeiro e atendimento ao cliente, para resolver pendências e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e regulamentações do setor de seguros. Suas atividades envolvem desde a coleta inicial de informações sobre o sinistro até a conclusão do processo, incluindo a liquidação de valores de indenização e o encerramento do caso de forma satisfatória para todas as partes. Este profissional tem um maior foco técnico, com uma relação mais profunda com as etapas de Regulação de Sinistros.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:


  • Receber e registrar notificações de sinistros relatados por segurados, corretores ou agentes, e realizar uma análise inicial das circunstâncias do sinistro (pré-análise)
  • Conduzir investigações detalhadas sobre a validade e a extensão do sinistro, incluindo a avaliação de danos, coleta de evidências e entrevistas com testemunhas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar vistoria remota assistida através das tecnologias da Sedgwick coletando imagens para compor o laudo/processo do Sinistro, de acordo com as especificidades de cada ramo, condições gerais do produto e determinações dos Clientes.
  • Determinar a aplicabilidade das coberturas da apólice ao sinistro reportado, verificando os termos, condições e limitações da apólice de seguro.
  • Estabelecer comunicação com os segurados para fornecer orientações sobre o processo de regulação de sinistros, esclarecer dúvidas e solicitar documentação adicional, quando necessário.
  • Negociar acordos e resoluções com os segurados, corretores, agentes ou terceiros envolvidos no sinistro, com o objetivo de alcançar uma solução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes, quando aplicável ao escopo contratado pelos Clientes da Sedgwick.
  • Solicitar e coletar documentos relevantes relacionados ao sinistro, como registros médicos, estimativas de reparo, relatórios policiais e outros documentos necessários para a análise e avaliação do sinistro, de acordo com a documentação exigida por cada Cliente para as coberturas dos produtos comercializados.
  • Determinar a responsabilidade das partes envolvidas no sinistro e avaliar os impactos na resolução do sinistro, considerando as leis, regulamentos, condições gerais do produto, coberturas e demais aspectos do sinistro que está sendo analisado, resultando em um pagamento total, parcial ou a uma negativa de indenização.
  • Avaliar os danos causados pelo sinistro e determinar os valores de indenização de acordo com as coberturas da apólice e os procedimentos estabelecidos pela Seguradora.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre a investigação, análise e resolução do sinistro, documentando todas as etapas do processo e as decisões tomadas, de acordo com o Book de Regras de cada Cliente da Sedgwick.
  • Monitorar e gerenciar pendências relacionadas aos sinistros em aberto, garantindo que sejam resolvidas de forma oportuna e eficiente, buscando apoio das áreas internas da Sedgwick, Seguradora ou Corretora e/ou buscando solucionar pendências junto ao cliente, como por exemplo a obtenção de documentação complementar.
  • Registrar todas as atividades, decisões e informações relevantes sobre os sinistros nos sistemas de gerenciamento de sinistros da Sedgwick e/ou dos Clientes, garantindo a precisão e a integridade dos dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, atendimento ao cliente, financeiro e etc, para resolver questões e pendências relacionadas aos sinistros, buscando sua solução com a maior qualidade possível no menor tempo possível.
  • Acompanhar o progresso e o status dos processos de regulação de sinistros, fornecendo atualizações regulares aos segurados e outras partes interessadas conforme determinado no Book de Regras de cada Cliente, de acordo com as respectivas réguas de comunicação pré-estabelecidas assim como os canais disponíveis.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades e decisões relacionadas à regulação de sinistros estejam em conformidade com as leis, regulamentação SUSEP, condições gerais do produto e suas respectivas coberturas e especificidades determinadas pelos Clientes da Sedgwick formalizadas em um Book de Regras.



FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ADICIONAIS:

  • Executar análise e solucionar pendências.
  • Avaliar circunstâncias do sinistro e coberturas reclamadas vs coberturas contratadas
  • Obter informações e evidências relevantes (como vistorias e/ou documentos complementares)
  • Atender KPI's e SLA's e identificar oportunidade de melhorias.
  • Realizar acompanhamentos, buscar soluções e acionar áreas Internas da Sedgwick ou do Cliente dependendo da situação apresentada no contato, objetivando compartilhar o caso e buscar apoio com a solução de pendências.



REQUISITOS


Educação e licenças

  • Superior Completo ou Cursando: Administração, Negócios ou Correlatas, Ciências Atuariais, Economia ou Finanças ou Correlatas, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação ou Correlatas, Gestão de Seguros ou Gestão de Riscos ou Direito ou Engenharia.
  • Diferencial caso possua Certificações SUSEP.


Experiência

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em uma posição similar atuando em um dos ramos: Responsabilidade civil (RC), Riscos Nomeados e Compreensivo empresarial.
  • Experiência anterior em BPO's, seguradoras ou corretoras
  • Compreensão detalhada das políticas de seguros, incluindo termos, condições, coberturas e exclusões das apólices, para determinar a aplicabilidade ao sinistro.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de investigação para coletar evidências, realizar entrevistas e verificar informações relacionadas ao sinistro.
  • Capacidade de interpretar e analisar documentos legais relevantes para o sinistro, como apólices de seguro, relatórios policiais, registros médicos, contratos de locação entre outros.
  • Gerenciamento de documentos, incluindo verificação de integridade, organização e indexação adequada dos documentos
  • Conhecimento das leis e regulamentos que regem a indústria de seguros, incluindo legislação de seguros, responsabilidade civil, proteção ao consumidor e privacidade de dados.
  • Nível Intermediário – Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel
  • Nível de Inglês Intermediário será considerado diferencial


Habilidades (Pleno) em:

  • Gestão do Tempo
  • Integração e Trabalho em Equipe
  • Empatia
  • Habilidade de Comunicação Assertiva
  • Pensamento Analítico
  • Proatividade e postura resolutiva
  • Multitarefa, Organização, Adaptabilidade e Flexibilidade

title: Analista de Controladoria de Fundos
description:
Sobre a Prisma:

A Prisma Capital é uma empresa de investimentos alternativos fundada em 2017 que oferece soluções criativas para problemas complexos que exigem capital de longo prazo. A equipe da Prisma Capital é experiente, multidisciplinar e com um histórico de mais de R$ 12bi implantados com retornos atrativos. A Prisma tem sede em São Paulo, 66 funcionários e possui em torno de R$ 22bi sob gestão.


A Prisma tem um mandato de investimento altamente flexível que inclui um espectro completo de transações estruturadas, independentemente do tamanho, classe de ativo ou setor. A Prisma acredita que essa abordagem multiestratégia é fundamental para a geração de retornos não correlacionados com os ciclos macroeconômicos brasileiros.


Overview da Posição:

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Controladoria com boa comunicação, senso crítico, com forte atenção aos detalhes e comprometido com a alta qualidade das entregas. O profissional será responsável por criar, implementar e acompanhar controles rigorosos para os ativos e passivos de toda a estrutura de fundos onshore e offshore da nossa gestora, além de coordenar o processo de auditoria e revisar as demonstrações financeiras e contábeis dos fundos.


Responsabilidade:

  • Controle das carteiras (Divulgação de cotas, reconciliação de informações divulgadas pelo administrador, validação de cálculos);
  • Suporte a áreas internas (Relatórios para investidores, fornecimento de informações regulatórias);
  • Suporte ao processo de auditoria dos fundos e revisão de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Controle de cotistas (Reconciliação das posições, análise de distribuições, chamadas de capital etc.);
  • Análise da rentabilidade dos fundos (Variações nos valores dos ativos e passivos, análise dos impactos mais relevantes);
  • Marcação a mercado de diversos tipos de ativos, líquidos e ilíquidos (Revisão e validação da precificação dos ativos em carteira, comparações com modelagens gerenciais);
  • Coordenação do processo de avaliação de ativos de Private Equity;


Desejável:

  • Coordenação das atividades de US tax compliance e reports de FATCA/CRS com prestadores;
  • Interface com administrador de fundos offshore sediados em Cayman, Canadá e USA, instruindo e revisando a contabilidade, demonstrações financeiras e notas explicativas.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, Econômicas, Contábeis, Administração e Engenharias;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Experiência anterior em asset management ou similar;
  • Diferencial: experiência em fundos offshore com investidores estrangeiros.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

  • Safeguard data integrity and compliance by ensuring configurations align with internal governance, audit requirements, and security standards.
  • Enhance user confidence and self-service adoption by contributing to the development of end-user training materials in partnership with HR.

Required:

Esse cargo coordena o fechamento contábil, supervisiona rotinas essenciais, apoia auditorias e assegura alinhamento com US GAAP e políticas corporativas. Inglês avançado e forte conhecimento técnico são essenciais.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Preparar e revisar lançamentos contábeis, análises de contas e demonstrações financeiras para reporte interno.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas (local, corporativa e SOX, quando aplicável), garantindo aderência aos controles internos e às políticas corporativas.
  • Revisar e aprimorar processos contábeis, controles internos, documentação e acuracidade do sistema.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de FP&A para suportar análises de variações e fornecer informações contábeis para relatórios gerenciais.
  • Interagir com times globais de contabilidade garantindo alinhamento entre práticas locais e padrões corporativos.
  • Apoiar a implementação ou melhoria de ERPs, sistemas contábeis e iniciativas de digitalização.
  • Coordenar o processo de demonstrações financeiras estatutárias, junto aos auditores externos.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis (obrigatória) com CRC ativo .
  • Experiência sólida em coordenação contábil, contabilidade geral ou controladoria.
  • Conhecimento avançado de US GAAP e das normas brasileiras (CPC/IFRS).
  • Vivência com rotinas tributárias e validação de impostos indiretos.
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) para interação com equipes globais.

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse Architect About the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

title: Reporter
description:
Risk Event-Driven Distressed (REDD) Intelligence is looking for a reporter to cover corporates in Brazil out of our office in Sao Paulo.

The reporter will have a notable track record covering and breaking news and a solid understanding of the corporate credit space, working closely with our experienced team of financial reporters and analysts to cover performing/distressed corporates in Brazil.


Day-to-day activities include:


  • Breaking news on corporate finance and operations, turnarounds and restructurings, legal, regulatory and market developments affecting Brazilian issuers
  • Working closely with our market-leading team of reporters and analysts across the global emerging markets
  • Analysis of finance, economics, legal situations and other data affecting corporates under coverage


Requirements:


  • A minimum three to five years’ experience with coverage of Brazil’s corporate space
  • A deep network of contacts in the business, asset management, banking, and legal communities
  • Knowledge of the corporate bond market and global/onshore credit
  • Facility with financial data and analysis related to coverage of the corporate space
  • Knowledge of the local dynamics affecting corporates under coverage
  • The ability to work collaboratively in a deadline-driven, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent English language writing skills


About REDD:


REDD produces real-time news and analysis on emerging market corporate and sovereign event-driven special situations, helping asset managers, bankers, and advisers assess opportunities in the high-yield and high-grade markets.

REDD is a strong proponent of gender and racial diversity, and an equal opportunity employer. We are a motivated team of free thinkers and expect our team members to be personable and dynamic, encouraging “out of the box” thinking and the ability to discuss and appreciate different points of view to avoid the blind spots presented by group think.

We can offer you an opportunity to pursue a challenging but rewarding career with ample progression within a diverse international organisation. We also offer a market-leading competitive salary package and flexible working arrangements.

Headquartered in London with bureaus across the global emerging markets, REDD Intelligence’s team is made up of professionals with investment banking, legal and financial reporting experience, leveraging regional relationships to report on catalysts related to a universe of over 3,500 companies and sovereigns under coverage.

title: Formulation Scientist
description:
Position Summary


The role will provide technical support for local laboratory work, with a primary focus on formulation development to support customer projects, the promotion of Vantage™ products, and customer events. Responsibilities include preparing reports and applying Vantage™ raw materials in formulations, with the goal of providing practical tools for the sales force and supporting strategic customers in the region.


The Research Scientist – Formulation & Application will be a science-driven project leader, responsible for planning, managing, supporting, and executing formulation and product development projects in LATAM, with a special emphasis on Brazil. This role will work closely with global R&D and Marketing teams, ideating, identifying, and developing new products for market launch, contributing to the growth of Vantage Personal Care in LATAM and globally.


Key responsibilities include developing formulations for major customers and evaluating their performance to demonstrate the benefits of our technologies, developing new personal care applications, and creating market-relevant concepts that promote Vantage™ technologies through marketing campaigns, customer events, trade shows, and industry activities. In addition, this role will design and perform (or coordinate) the necessary

performance tests to demonstrate and reinforce the value proposition of Vantage™ technologies.


Position Scope


The position will be located in Brasil.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


· Development of new formulations to highlight ingredients from Vantage portfolio and their added values in formulation (skin care, hair care, makeup, and toiletries applications) according to internal and external needs, such as Marketing campaigns, trade shows, customers events and needs etc.

· Support in tests for performance studies and sensorial tests for costumer projects.

· Contribute to new product development projects to improve VPC product portfolio, including discovering new products based on market trends and customers feedback, assessing technical feasibility, developing the new product, designing and conducting needed performance tests to improve the product design, and finalizing product specs, etc.

· Monitor stability testing of formulations: organoleptic and physicochemical analyses.

· Qualification of Vantage ingredients and issue the report with the results.

· Ensure the efficient operation of the laboratory (respect for SOPs, raw materials and packaging inventory management…).

· Use knowledge of routine laboratory safety procedures, SDS’s and interpretations of hazards/toxicity data to perform all laboratory work in accordance with the written safety manual and site safety policies.

· Be a steward for safety and continually drive awareness to ensure a safe work environment for all employees.

· Understand formulation procedures and technologies and incorporate this understanding into applications that add value to customer products.

· Maintain accurate records of all laboratory work and research in accordance with generally accepted laboratory principles.

· Manage the calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment.


Note: The duties listed above are not all inclusive and may be subject to periodic updating or revision.


Education & Experience:


Education: Bachelor of Chemistry, Pharmacobiology, Cosmetics Technology, Pharmacy or related areas, linked to sciences (Chemistry).


Experience: between 5 to 8 years’ working experience in the cosmetics and chemical industry.




Knowledge, Skills, & Talents


· Spanish and English speaker.

· Knowledge of development Personal Care products (Formulation & process).

· Being responsible, organized, proactive, problem-solving, easy to work in a team are characteristics inherent to the vacancy profile

· Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

· Ability to influence and work in cross functional teams.

· Excellent communication skills (oral and written) and interpersonal skills.

· Natural collaborator, contributing to a positive team dynamic.

· Continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to optimize processes.



Working Conditions


Hybrid model
