title: Senior Technical Manager – Fixed Networks & Infrastructure
description:
About This Role

We're seeking an exceptional Senior Technical Manager who will architect and orchestrate mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure that powers millions of connections across Latin America. This is your opportunity to drive technological innovation, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of fixed network solutions.


What You'll Do


Strategic Leadership

  • Architect and deploy carrier-grade fixed network solutions across fiber optics, GPON/EPON, SDN/NFV, and bearer network ecosystems
  • Master end-to-end bearer networks: optical transport (DWDM/OTN), metro aggregation, IP/MPLS backbone, and microwave transmission
  • Lead and develop multidisciplinary technical teams (15+ engineers) driving innovation and operational excellence
  • Drive technical strategy for large-scale network transformation projects aligned with business objectives


Operational Excellence

  • Execute logical deployment strategies including provisioning, service activation, and zero-touch deployment frameworks
  • Command Tier 3/4 technical support operations with root cause analysis and incident elimination protocols
  • Optimize warranty lifecycle and spares inventory ensuring <99% equipment availability
  • Delivery measurable improvements: 99.99%+ uptime, 40%+ MTTR reduction, enhanced operational efficiency


Technical Mastery

  • Eliminate network bottlenecks through proactive capacity planning and infrastructure optimization
  • Orchestrate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and enforce SLA compliance
  • Establish comprehensive technical documentation and deployment playbooks
  • Champion adoption of 5G integration, edge computing, and automated network management


What You Bring


Required Experience

  • Experience in telecommunications infrastructure and in senior technical leadership;
  • Proven track record deploying large-scale networks (1MM+ subscribers or equivalent);
  • Expert-level troubleshooting across physical and logical layers;
  • Demonstrated success managing technical support operations and ITIL frameworks.


Bearer Network Expertise (Must Have)

  • Optical Transport: DWDM, OTN (OTU/ODU), SDH/SONET, WDM systems, EDFA, dispersion management
  • Fiber Infrastructure: Dark fiber, OPGW, aerial/underground deployment, OTDR testing
  • Metro & Aggregation: Carrier Ethernet (MEF), MPLS-TP, Metro WDM, PTN
  • IP/MPLS Backbone: Core routing, MPLS VPN (L2/L3), traffic engineering, segment routing, BGP/ISIS
  • Access Networks: PON (GPON/XG-PON/XGS-PON/NG-PON2), Active Ethernet, FTTx architectures
  • Microwave Transmission: P2P links, spectrum planning, link budget calculations


Technical Skills

  • Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RSVP, LDP, TCP/IP, SIP, VoIP
  • Logical provisioning systems, EMS/NMS platforms, network orchestration tools
  • Advanced diagnostics: OTDR, OSA, BERT, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers
  • OSS/BSS systems, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds), ServiceNow, Jira
  • Automation: Ansible, Python scripting
  • Cloud-native architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, DevOps methodologies
  • Multi-vendor platforms: ZTE, Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, Cisco optical/routing equipment


Deployment & Operations

  • Complex cutover management and phased rollout strategies with zero service disruption
  • Multi-tier support framework design and escalation matrix implementation
  • Data-driven spares management and predictive maintenance programs
  • Vendor negotiation and RMA cycle management
  • Process automation and provisioning timeline reduction


Leadership Capabilities

  • Proven ability to identify and develop high-potential talent, assessing how candidates think and solve problems under pressure
  • Building high-performing teams in fast-paced, demanding environments
  • Strategic mindset balancing operational needs with long-term architectural vision
  • Cross-functional collaboration across deployment, support, procurement, and vendor management


Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • MBA in Project Management is a plus.
  • Certifications highly valued: CCNP/CCIE (Service Provider), JNCIP-SP, ITIL Foundation/Expert
  • Bilingual: Portuguese (native/fluent) and English (advanced communication as primary working language)


Plus/Nice to Have

  • Wireless network experience (4G/5G RAN, microwave backhaul, small cells, DAS)
  • Wireless-wireline convergence architectures
  • Spectrum management and RF planning knowledge


Why Join Us


✅ Strategic Influence: Direct access to executive leadership shaping company direction

✅ Technical Autonomy: Select technologies, design architectures, and optimize operations

✅ Operational Impact: Transform deployment, support, and maintenance organization-wide

✅ Market Leadership: Partner with tier-1 carriers on

✅ Career Growth: Clear pathway to progress inside the company

✅ Competitive Package: Industry-leading compensation aligned with performance outcomes

title: Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil)
description:
We are a leading global fintech company providing cross-border payment solutions to enterprises worldwide, with operations across North America, Europe, the UK, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. As we strategically expand into the Brazilian market, we are seeking a seasoned Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil) to ensure full compliance of our local operations with Brazilian financial regulations, data protection laws (LGPD), AML/KYC requirements, and payment system frameworks. This role will serve as the primary liaison with local regulators (e.g., Banco Central do Brasil, Receita Federal, ANPD), lead compliance implementation, adapt technical systems to regulatory expectations, and support routine audits, while closely collaborating with global compliance and engineering teams to embed compliance into product development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical compliance liaison between the company and Brazilian regulators (including but not limited to Banco Central do Brasil, CVM, ANPD, Receita Federal);representing the engineering in regulatory engagements that involve system architecture, data flows, business contingency, audit logging, and other technical implementation aspects of compliance.
  • Participate in Brazil market-related requirements and project reviews, providing technical compliance oversight to assess requirements and ensure that products, technical architecture, and operational processes comply with Brazilian financial, payments, and data privacy regulations (such as LGPD, PIX-related rules, and BCB Resolutions), thereby enabling legally compliant business operations.;
  • Collaborate with global Compliance, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable technical specifications and system controls;
  • Support internal and external audits (e.g., SOX, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001) and prepare regulatory filings and compliance reports;
  • Continuously monitor regulatory developments in Brazil, assess impact on existing business and technical architecture, and propose mitigation strategies;
  • Drive the systematic and standardized documentation of technical artifacts to enhance compliance efficiency and auditability;
  • Provide compliance training and guidance to local business teams to foster a strong compliance culture.



Qualifications:


Required Qualifications

  • Language : Native-level Portuguese (written and spoken); fluent English for global collaboration;
  • Local Regulatory Knowledge : Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial regulatory landscape, including BCB payment system rules (e.g., PIX, SPB), AML/CFT regulations, and LGPD data protection requirements;
  • Technical Acumen : Familiarity with modern payment technology architectures (e.g., API-first, microservices, cloud infrastructure); ability to engage engineering teams on technical details such as data flows, encryption, and audit logging;
  • Hands-on Experience : Direct experience engaging with Brazilian regulators, submitting licensing applications, or managing on-site inspections;
  • Education : Bachelor’s degree or higher in Law, Finance, Information Technology, Risk Management, or related field.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Hold professional certifications such as CISSP, CAMS, CRCM, or similar;
  • Prior experience in fintech, payment institutions, or banking compliance roles;
  • Familiarity with international compliance standards (e.g., FATF Recommendations, GDPR, PCI-DSS) and their local implementation;
  • Experience working in multicultural teams and supporting cross-border compliance initiatives.


What We Offer


  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class compliance and engineering experts;
  • Continuous professional development and learning resources;
  • Inclusive, diverse, and results-driven culture.

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.



Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.

title: Integration Solution-Team Leader
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management & Goal Achievement: Oversee daily operations and team management of the integration solution group, allocate resources reasonably, and lead the team to achieve goals in system integration, product optimization, and customer support.
  2. Integration Project Coordination & Delivery: Lead the planning, implementation, and delivery of integration projects involving external API service providers, hardware devices (such as printers), and internal systems, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
  3. Technical Solution Design & Optimization: Analyze customer and business needs, coordinate with technical teams to implement system connectivity, process optimization, and new feature development, continuously improving the quality and stability of overall integration solutions.
  4. Quality & Process Control: Establish and optimize team collaboration, product testing, launch processes, and integration standards; monitor key indicators to ensure high-standard deliverables.
  5. Complex Problem Solving & Technical Challenges: Lead the team to analyze and resolve complex technical issues in project integration and device operation, promote targeted technical solutions, and ensure successful client implementation.
  6. Cross-Departmental Communication & Collaboration: Act as the core liaison within the team, work closely with sales, technical, product, and operation teams to coordinate project progress and improve business synergy.
  7. Team Development & Capability Building: Develop and organize systematic training and growth plans for team members, continuously identify and cultivate talents, and build a high-performing and cohesive team.
  8. Industry Trend Insights & Innovation: Stay updated on order-taking solution development in the restaurant/merchant industry, including APIs, hardware, and apps; drive innovation in integration solutions and lead the professional advancement of the team.


Job Requirements

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Information Management, E-commerce, or related fields.
  2. At least 3 years of experience in technical integration, system implementation, product operations, or related team management, with a preference for experience in large-scale API, hardware, or integrated solution project management.
  3. Strong technical solution analysis, design, and optimization abilities; able to systematically solve complex technical and business problems.
  4. Familiar with API interfaces, hardware products (such as printers), apps, and various integration methods; deep understanding of overall solutions for the merchant industry is a plus.
  5. Outstanding cross-team communication, coordination, and project management skills; able to drive collaboration and achieve project goals.
  6. Ability to organize team training and development, nurture talent, and build a high-performing team.
  7. Results-oriented, highly resilient, and self-driven, with awareness of process optimization and high-standard quality control.
  8. Native-level Portuguese and strong proficiency in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing); able to communicate efficiently in an international and diverse environment. 9.Experience in restaurant/merchant integration projects or industry solution operations is a plus.


Job Highlights

  1. Early-Stage Business: Opportunity to participate in early-stage planning, design, and implementation of team and projects, driving core technology and product innovation.
  2. International Team: Work with colleagues from 26 countries, experience a diverse and open work environment, and expand your global perspective.

title: Tech Lead (Chatbot Development)
description:
Sinch is at the forefront of transforming customer communications, offering innovative solutions that empower businesses around the globe. We are looking for a Tech Lead specializing in Conversational Solutions to guide our talented engineers and help shape our cutting-edge platforms.

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing and enhancing our conversational AI solutions, integrating advanced technologies such as NLP and machine learning to deliver exceptional user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of conversational solutions, including chatbots and voice initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • Architect and design scalable systems that can handle real-time interactions and integrate various channels of communication.
  • Guide and mentor a team of engineers, promoting best practices and innovation in software development.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver high-quality products.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in conversational AI and incorporate relevant advancements into Sinch's offerings.
  • Ensure robust testing and deployment processes, maintaining high standards of code quality and system reliability.
  • Actively contribute to the team's success by driving initiatives, providing technical guidance, and fostering a collaborative environment.



Requirements

  • Experience performing as technical lead of Software Development team.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in software development, with a strong focus on AI and conversational solutions.
  • Expertise in programming Low Code (Dialogue Flow, IBM Watson), NodeJS, JavaScript, Golang ou outras linguagens microsservices
  • Experience with NLP technologies and frameworks (e.g., Rasa, Dialogflow, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of microservices, cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proven experience in leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, and driving collaborative projects.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a passion for developing innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English
  • Experience with real-time messaging platforms and API integrations.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management tools.



Benefits

Sinch is a global company composed of people from different countries and cultures. Our benefits adjust regionally to support employees and help them to thrive in every stage of life. We offer valuable benefits and resources, including health and life insurance, a flexible work environment, retirement savings plans, and more.


  • STAY HEALTHY: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • FLEXIBLE BENEFITS: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • FAMILY FIRST: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • EVERYDAY WELLBEING: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • TAKE A BREAK: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

title: Country Leader, Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.


The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.


Key Responsibilities


1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.g., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program; adapt strategy proactively


2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities; b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure; c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators; and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.


3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.


4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.


5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.


6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized; access to waste management; jobs created; safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.


7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).


Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job 

In SME credit, advantage compounds through disciplined underwriting, fast learning cycles, and early detection of risks. As our Credit Analyst, you will strengthen our underwriting edge by translating financial data, behavioural signals, and real-world borrower performance into precise credit decisions- while continuously feeding insights back into our core decision models.


Responsibilities

  • Conduct holistic credit analysis for SMEs: financials, cash-flows, tax compliance, bank data, concentration risks, behavioural signals.
  • Produce concise, decision-ready credit memos with recommendations (approve / adjust / decline).
  • Lead periodic reviews of high-exposure borrowers - liquidity evolution, leverage shifts, payment patterns, and macro impacts.
  • Evaluate and recommend credit-limit increases based on performance, updated financials, and risk appetite.
  • Maintain a closed-loop feedback mechanism between underwriting decisions and portfolio outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Data to translate recurring insights into better thresholds, features, and model logic.
  • Support portfolio monitoring with early-warning detection and risk-mitigation recommendations.
  • Ensure underwriting discipline and audit-ready documentation.


Qualifications

  • 2–3 years in IB, credit, structured credit, asset management, DCM or fintech underwriting.
  • Strong financial analysis: liquidity, leverage, coverage, working-capital dynamics, seasonality.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian tax reporting, accounting regimes, and corporate structures.
  • Experience writing clear, investor-grade credit memos.
  • Understanding of credit models (inputs, outputs, sensitivity) and ability to evaluate their strengths/weaknesses.
  • Bonus: exposure to securitisation, structured credit, data-driven underwriting.
  • High analytical rigor and precision in judgment.
  • “Manager of one”- delivers independently with consistency.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, both in English and Portuguese.
  • Proactive in identifying trends, risks, and model improvement opportunities.
  • Thrives in a high-velocity, high-accountability environment.
  • Passion for modernising Brazil’s B2B credit market through technology and transparency.
  • Integrity, long-term thinking, and intellectual honesty.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Itaim Bibi, Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

title: Especialista VMO
description:
QUEM SOMOS?


Uma das maiores seguradoras do mundo, temos como pilar a sustentabilidade e o cuidado com as pessoas. Possuímos um amplo portfólio de produtos e diversas unidades em que atuamos: Investimentos, Consórcios, Capitalização, Previdência e Vida Resgatável, Saúde, Seguros e Assistência. Trabalhamos para construir o futuro e somos comprometidos com a inovação.

Estamos nos transformando para poder acompanhar nossos clientes também no mundo digital. Com presença em mais de 100 países nos cinco continentes, somamos mais de 34 mil colaboradores em todo o mundo, mais de 3,5 mil só no Brasil.

A Fundación MAPFRE, instituição sem fins lucrativos, é a nossa acionista majoritária, o que fortalece a nossa independência e estabilidade. Entre nossos compromissos está a valorização e apoio à diversidade e inclusão, construindo ambientes mais acolhedores.

A presença de mulheres em cargo de gestão, a contratação de PCDs e o equilíbrio racial e de gênero na constituição das equipes é a nossa prioridade.


QUEM QUEREMOS NO NOSSO TIME


Pessoas proativas e inovadoras, capazes de identificar de forma contínua novas oportunidades e soluções para transformar algo bom em algo melhor;

Que colaborem, porque a capacidade de cooperar, contribuir e compartilhar com pessoas que têm pontos de vista diferentes nos ajudará a conseguir melhores resultados;

Que gerenciem as mudanças de forma ágil e tomem decisões rápidas e eficazes;

Que tenham curiosidade para aprender, se desenvolver, crescer e sentir que estão contribuindo aos objetivos da empresa.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER COMO ESPECIALISTA VMO


  • Conduzir a construção de planos de negócio para os projetos estratégicos da companhia com a viabilidade financeira e geração de valor, apoiando a tomada de decisão para priorização e desenvolvimento;
  • Realizar acompanhamento dos projetos junto às áreas clientes durante e pós desenvolvimento, garantindo que estejam vinculados às metas e objetivos estratégicos, bem como seu atingimento com report executivo;
  • Preparar relatórios e apresentações executivas para informar o progresso e os resultados dos projetos, destacando pontos de desvio e risco da entrega.
  • Manter comunicação clara e contínua com todos os stakeholders, promovendo a transparência das atividades do VMO.
  • Organizar agendas semanais de acompanhamento dos projetos estratégicos, visando identificar, avaliar e reportar desvios de prazo e orçamentário, bem como apoiar em ações para mitigação de riscos;
  • Garantir visão integrada entre os projetos;
  • Atuação em ambiente dinâmico, levantamento de requisitos/premissas para projetos estratégicos e interação com diferentes áreas da organização




O QUE A MAPFRE ESPERA DE VOCÊ


  • Ensino Superior Completo em áreas financeiras ou correlatas;
  • Sólido conhecimento financeiro e capacidade de análise de indicadores de desempenho;
  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para dialogar com a alta gestão.
  • Experiência em levantamento de premissas e acompanhamento de projetos ágeis;
  • Diferencial: experiência prévia com ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e uso de ferramentas de apoio (Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint).


LOCAL DE TRABALHO: SÃO PAULO/ W Torre -SP (3 dias presenciais e 2 dias trabalho remoto)


CUIDAMOS DOS NOSSOS


A MAPFRE é feita de pessoas, por isso retribuímos da melhor maneira possível o comprometimento de nossos colaboradores, que contam com:


  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação e, uma vez por ano um VA em dobro, tudo 100% subsidiado pela empresa;

title: Systems Engineer
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.


This role will cover either our open B (4PM - 12PM) and C (12PM-8AM) shift as well as weekends.


Job Summary:

The Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the deployment of complete systems that include Clever Devices products combined with complementary technologies, including deployment of hardware products and interfaces, to provide a holistic solution that meets customer requirements.

The Systems Engineer works closely with the project team to analyze the customer requirements and required functionality early in the project cycle; create design documents, system architecture, requirement matrix and support the customer design reviews, conduct the Factory Acceptance Testing with the customer and lead the subsequent deployment at the Customer site. Execute and complete the System Acceptance Testing along with the customer and all other parties involved in the project

The Systems Engineer coordinates all system development and integration tasks to include design, integration and formal testing. The Systems Engineer also works to support the Systems Engineering team.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supports the definition of software and hardware products and interfaces
  • Coordinates system development tasks to include design, integration and formal testing
  • Oversees all transitions into customer’s deployment
  • Develops and completes projects in system specifications, technical and logistical requirements and other disciplines
  • Creates and maintains programmatic and technical documentation (design docs, requirement matrix, system diagrams, etc) to insure efficient planning and execution
  • Manages and documents system configurations
  • Ensures the deployment of the solution is successful
  • Maintains a thorough working knowledge of enterprise applications such as BusTime and CleverCAD
  • Implements Performance analysis and reliability analysis of the end to end protocol
  • Adheres to protocol revisions and amendments as directed by the Regional Systems Engineering Manager
  • Assists in other tasks as needed by the Systems Engineering department
  • Provides training and guidance to Associates, Project Engineer I/II as needed.


Skills Required:

  • 10+ years experience in engineering development
  • 10+ years experience in systems engineering involving hardware, software, data and communications technologies
  • Good understanding of the J1939 and J1708 protocols and experience with Multiplex systems
  • Hardware design experience and ability to read electrical schematics
  • Experience with hardware troubleshooting and lab equipment
  • Experience with network and protocol troubleshooting and tools
  • Working knowledge of one or more of the following: C and C++, SQL, VB, JavaScript, HTML, ASP, python, databases, report generation and networking
  • Ability to independently gather and document requirements and provide design requirements and product definition
  • Strong computer skills particularly with MS Office including Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint and Project.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize
  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Bachelors Degree in Engineering or Computer Engineering required, Masters Degree in related discipline.
  • Experience working with public transit is a plus

title: Data Scientist
description:
DYWIDAG stands as a global leader in construction and infrastructure technology that works with government authorities, asset owners, construction companies, and design offices to support their infrastructure projects. We have expanded into over 50 countries worldwide and continue to keep infrastructure safe and secure every single day.


Purpose of the Job

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of hands-on experience as a data scientist in a business environment, supporting multiple departments and functions with predictive analytics and rapid development of minimal viable products (MVPs). A strong emphasis is placed on experience with pricing engines and sales forecasting solutions. You will be responsible for analyzing large datasets, building predictive models, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured data from diverse sources.
  • Develop, implement, and optimize statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques.
  • Rapidly prototype and deliver MVPs to address business needs, especially in pricing and sales forecasting.
  • Collaborate with the Global BI Team and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.
  • Support various departments (e.g., Sales, Finance, Operations) with tailored predictive models and insights.
  • Visualize data insights using dashboards and reports, primarily with Power BI.
  • Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders through presentations and documentation.
  • Continuously improve data quality, analytical processes, and model performance.
  • Stay current with the latest trends and technologies in data science, machine learning, and AI.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of proven experience as a data scientist in a business setting, supporting multiple departments/functions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in developing predictive models for pricing engines and sales forecasting.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud platforms is preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Spark, Hadoop).
  • Knowledge of deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Industry experience in Construction is preferred; experience in Manufacturing or Engineering-related Big Data is also relevant.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.


Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.

description:

  • Serve as the lead consultant for designing, configuring, and rolling out enhancements across Sales Cloud and CPQ.

  • Configure core Sales Cloud components—including lead management, opportunity tracking, account and contact management, product and pricing setup, and the full quoting lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in technology, computer science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years working with Salesforce Sales Cloud in a configuration or implementation role.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on Salesforce CPQ experience.
  • Strong command of Sales Cloud data structures, platform capabilities, and standard functionality.
  • In-depth knowledge of CPQ configuration principles including product setup, pricing, discounting, and quoting mechanics.
  • Experience with Apex, Visualforce, LWCs, or integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi) is a plus.

title: Gerente SHE
description:
O Gerente de SHE é responsável pela implementação, otimização e gestão de processos da área de Segurança do Trabalho dentro de uma organização. Ele garante que a operação dos serviços seja eficientes, alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da área.


  • Assegurar o atendimento aos requisitos legais e corporativos aplicáveis a segurança do trabalho, objetivando a não ocorrência de acidentes e não conformidades.
  • Avaliar as condições ambientais de trabalho (riscos físicos), emitir relatório técnico e indicar medidas de controle.
  • Atuar imediatamente qualquer atividade que apresente risco grave e iminente de acidente do trabalho ou doença ocupacional.
  • Identificar e analisar riscos, acidentes e falhas, investigar as causas e propor medidas preventivas e corretivas para prevenir potenciais incidentes e/ou acidentes.
  • Acompanhar peritos e auditores nas avaliações ambientais e fiscalizações trabalhistas.
  • Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas do sistema integrado de gestão de acordo com as normas ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001. Garantir o atendimento ao plano de ação das observações e não conformidades registradas.
  • Monitorar os dados estatísticos de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais e do trabalho, calcular a frequência e a gravidade.
  • Assegurar a gestão de equipe sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Promover a comunicação entre a Segurança e a gerência/diretoria dos sites.
  • Oferecer suporte ao negócio ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto desde o planejamento, supervisão, monitoramento e documentação para assegurar a conformidade com os aspectos internos, externos e legais relacionados.


Requisitos:

  • Formação específica como engenheiro e com Pós-graduação em Segurança do Trabalho (habilitação nacional para o exercício da sua função).
  • Experiência com implantação de sistemas de gestão em Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente e/ou Liderança de Projetos na área.
  • Experiência com NR’s.
  • Experiência com clientes do ramo de logística.
  • Experiência em gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas, aplicação de treinamentos, direção e experiência para ajudar a resolver desafios.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas Google Office, Microsoft Office, Power BI (será um diferencial).
  • Fluência em espanhol.


Atividades:

  • Elaborar os procedimentos, padrões, normas e instruções de trabalho para o desenvolvimento do serviço nos clientes.
  • Identificar requisitos legais e do cliente e integrá-los em documentos operacionais.
  • Treinar e capacitar equipe operacional.
  • Definir e elaborar os indicadores de segurança, gestão de serviços e implementar planos de melhoria.
  • Assessorar a equipe de supervisores e técnicos de segurança sobre riscos, controles e ações para garantir o cumprimento das normas do cliente.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Scope : Senior executive officer responsible for the overall management and legal representation of the company in Brazil, ensuring full compliance with applicable laws and regulations, alignment with group strategy, and sound governance, risk and control frameworks. Acts as the company’s legal representative alongside other three directors before public authorities, regulators, financial institutions and key partners.


Key responsibilities : • Corporate management: lead the implementation of the business plan in Brazil, follow HQ priorities and ensure operational and financial targets are met. • Legal representation: act as the company’s legal representative before the Central Bank of Brazil and other regulators, tax authorities, courts, financial institutions, partners and suppliers, signing contracts, powers of attorney and corporate documents. • Regulatory relationship: maintain a constructive and transparent relationship with Brazilian regulators and self-regulatory bodies, including responding to inspections, official inquiries and information requests. • Financial stewardship: approve budgets according to HQ instructions, monitor cash flow, capital and liquidity needs, and ensure timely and accurate financial according to the finance team and regulatory reporting. • People and culture: build and lead the local leadership team, promote an ethical culture, and ensure adherence to the company’s code of conduct and policies, acting in a horizontal relationship alongside officers responsible for AML/CFT, Internal Controls & Compliance, and Risk, Capital & Disclosure.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional experience, with solid background in financial services, payments, fintech and/or crypto, including prior experience in leadership or management roles;
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape applicable to the business (Central Bank of Brazil, COAF and, where relevant, CVM and other authorities).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering or a related field; a MBA or similar is a plus.
  • Proven leadership, stakeholder-management and decision-making skills, with a hands-on, ownership mindset.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must be resident in Brazil.
  • No disqualifying factors as described below:

I — not to be barred by special law, nor convicted of bankruptcy crimes, tax evasion, malfeasance, active or passive bribery, extortion, embezzlement, crimes against the popular economy, public faith, property, or the National Financial System, nor sentenced to a penalty that prohibits, even temporarily, access to public office;

II — not to have been declared disqualified or suspended from serving in statutory or contractual bodies at institutions authorized to operate by the Central Bank of Brazil or at pension entities, insurance companies, capitalization companies, publicly held companies, or entities subject to the supervision of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Brazil (CVM);

III — not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;

IV — unblemished reputation;

V — knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;

VI — technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: PM/PO Sênior
description:
Sobre a Consorciei

Somos a fintech líder no mercado de consórcios e estamos transformando a indústria com tecnologia e capital.


Desenvolvemos plataformas whitelabel e soluções com IA generativa que trazem eficiência às administradoras e uma experiência digital completa para os clientes — do momento da compra até o pós-venda.

Missão do cargo:

Liderar a evolução e o sucesso do produto de cobrança com IA da Consorciei, desde discovery até scale-up, garantindo adoção pelas administradoras, performance de recuperação e experiência superior para clientes finais.

  • Liderar implantação, parametrização de regras de negociação/régua, monitorar resultados, criar playbooks e suportar equipes das administradoras;
  • Comunicar progresso, riscos e decisões; promover alinhamento e transparência;
  • Estabelecer SLAs, métricas de confiabilidade, gestão de incidentes e documentação do produto.



Requisitos obrigatórios pra vaga:

  • PO/PM em produtos digitais, preferencialmente fintech, bancos, meios de pagamento ou crédito;
  • Vivência em produtos B2B ou B2B2C, com integrações via APIs e implantação em clientes enterprise;

  • Excelente comunicação e escrita;
  • Inglês(básico/intermediário) para leitura técnica;


✨Diferenciais:

  • Experiência direta em cobrança/recuperação de crédito (régua de cobrança, negociação);
  • Vivência com administradoras de consórcios ou produtos para esse segmento;
  • Experiência com produtos de IA generativa/conversacional (LLMs, prompt design, guardrails, avaliação);
  • Conhecimento de WhatsApp Business API, provedores CPaaS (ex.: Zenvia, Twilio), CRMs e contact center;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Looker/Power BI/Metabase e Jira.



Pra nossas pessoas

A gente acredita que cuidar de quem faz a Consorciei acontecer é o que impulsiona o nosso crescimento.

Estamos no modelo hibrido, 3x por semana no escritório! próximo da estação Fradique Coutinho/Faria Lima.

title: Testing & commissioning Engineer

title: Risk Management Manager
description:
As the Safety Risk Manager, you will play a pivotal role in building the future of safety risk

management at Keeta.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Lead data analysis and modeling for platform risk scenarios
  • Conduct risk identification, classification, and early-warning analysis across rider/driver/courier, merchant, and customer segments.
  • Perform bottom-up data discovery and metric construction
  • Conduct in-depth EDA using raw mobility/delivery platform data (orders, location traces, incentives, behavioral logs).
  • Build standardized risk metrics, operational metrics, behavior features, and monitoring indicators from the ground up.
  • Apply top-down business perspective to drive strategy and execution
  • Work closely with product, operations, policy, and risk teams to translate high-level business goals into measurable and actionable metrics.
  • Drive 0→1 metric system design for new markets or new products, and evolve metrics for rapid growth and later-stage refinement.
  • Develop dashboards and risk monitoring systems
  • Build and maintain BI dashboards to monitor key risk, quality, safety, and operational metrics.
  • Detect anomalies, conduct root-cause analysis, and support incident response and post-mortem reviews.
  • Support cross-functional decision making and risk strategy design
  • Provide data-driven insights to support risk mitigation strategies, counter-measure design, operational policy updates, and business optimization.
  • Evaluate the impact of policy or product changes, and create closed-loop measurement frameworks.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations Research, Data Science, or related fields.


Technical Skills


  • Proficient in SQL and Python/R for data processing, modeling, and analysis.
  • Solid knowledge of machine learning methods (logistic regression, decision trees, anomaly detection, clustering) is preferred.
  • Strong ability to understand raw data structures and build robust metric definitions.
  • Risk Experience (Core Requirement)
  • Experience in risk analytics, trust & safety, fraud detection, operational risk, or platform governance—preferably in mobility, delivery, or other two-sided marketplace industries.
  • Familiar with risk assessment lifecycle: identification → quantification → monitoring → mitigation.
  • Bottom-Up Analytical Capability
  • Ability to investigate raw data (orders, trajectory data, incentives, cancellations, GPS signals, courier/driver behavior) and derive structured metrics and actionable insights.
  • Top-Down Business and Strategy Thinking
  • Ability to understand business models such as supply-demand balancing, delivery SLA, driver/courier incentives, merchant performance, and safety/quality frameworks.
  • Proven experience in designing and scaling 0→1→N metric systems supporting business objectives.
  • Project Experience (strong preferred but not necessary)
  • Experience supporting new market entry, new product launches, or rapid-scale operations is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical reasoning, structured communication, and data storytelling abilities.
  • Ability to convert complex analysis into clear, practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with high attention to detail.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Incentive Planning
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!


What You'll Do

  1. Performance Incentive Design: Develop rational sales performance frameworks aligned with business development stages and supply strategy, to drive strategy implementation and goal achievement.
  2. Execution & Continuous Improvement: Lead end-to-end implementation of performance plans: plan communication, progress tracking, settlement calculations, and result reviews. Collaborate with sales teams to evaluate execution effectiveness, identify gaps, and iteratively refine sales strategies to ensure solution viability.
  3. System & Process Optimization: Optimize performance management systems and processes, and partner with the product team to build tools that enhance efficiency.

What We Need From You

  1. experience in business analysis or data analysis is preferred, with experience in performance evaluation, target design, or sales strategy preferred.
  2. High business sensitivity, proficient in using SQL, Excel, skilled at identifying problems from data and proposing solutions.
  3. Strong communication and teamwork skills, able to effectively coordinate resources across departments.
  4. Strong work planning skills, meticulous, and highly responsible for deliverables.


What Makes This Role Exciting

  1. Target performance is one of the key levers to drive the sales team to achieve the company's overall goals, with strong implementation feasibility.
  2. Deep involvement in all aspects of business target and supply strategy formulation, close to business operations.
  3. Opportunity to deeply understand the operational mechanisms of the food delivery business, collaborate across functions, and achieve significant personal growth.


4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.
